column1: # Which Record Atlas region (the versioned context.json contract) each place string this archive prints beside a date on a person's page belongs to, for the
# 'at the time' notes (site/src/pages/people/[slug].astro, kit/docs/era-notes.md). One row per place string AS PRINTED: the born, died and marriage places of
# every person who is not living. A region of '-' means: looked at, and no Atlas region covers it (or the string is not one place), so no note. A new place
# string in the data fails tools/build_era.py --check until it is decided here. A region is given only where the region CLEARLY covers the place: England and
# Wales (one region), Queensland, Scotland, Ireland (the island), and the few continental regions the Atlas has. erasnap.py then refuses any town whose point
# (data/era-towns.tsv, column 4 here names the town) falls in a DIFFERENT region's ring, or within 15 km of its own region's ring edge.
